edges.reason: msg.sender indexes the sender balance and delegate record that transfer modifies
value parameter is the fragment amount being transferred
yamValue derived from the transfer value is subtracted from and added to _yamBalances entries
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient underlying balances
transfer invokes _moveDelegates after balances are updated
transfer divides the value by yamsScalingFactor, so rounding/truncation of the scaling factor can strand dust
transferFrom debits _allowedFragments[from][msg.sender] so the caller identity determines which allowance is spent
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in _allowedFragments
transferFrom moves underlying balance from `from` to `to`
transferFrom updates delegation votes after the balance move
mint is gated by onlyMinter which compares msg.sender to rebaser/gov/incentivizer/migrator
the mint amount is scaled into initSupply and totalSupply arithmetic
mint increases initSupply
mint increases totalSupply by the scaled amount
mint requires yamsScalingFactor to stay below the max scaling factor
mint assigns delegates to the new balance via _moveDelegates
migrator is one of the accounts accepted by the onlyMinter modifier
rebaser is one of the accounts accepted by the onlyMinter modifier
rebase is restricted to the configured rebaser address
indexDelta scales the yamsScalingFactor via mul and div by BASE, permitting truncation
epoch is carried into the Rebase event
positive selects the increase or decrease branch of the scaling factor update
newScalingFactor is compared against the max scaling factor before being written
rebase writes a new yamsScalingFactor computed with integer division that may truncate
rebase recomputes totalSupply from initSupply and the new scaling factor
_setRebaser changes the address that gates the rebase function
_setRebaser is gated on the gov state variable
msg.sender must equal gov to call _setRebaser
_acceptGov requires msg.sender to equal pendingGov and promotes it
_acceptGov overwrites the gov state variable
msg.sender identity is the authorization condition for _acceptGov
payout relies on block.timestamp to determine the vested amount (timestamp dependency)
streamId selects which stream entry is paid out
payout calls _claimable to compute the amount to pay
the memory Stream copy supplies startTime, length and totalAmount to _claimable
_claimable derives elapsed time from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency)
claimableUnderlying is computed with mul/div/sub arithmetic on the stream amounts
payout writes the increased amountPaidOut back into streams[streamId]
payout subtracts the claimable amount from totalUnclaimedInStreams
payout performs an external call yam.transferUnderlying(recipient, amount), handing control to another contract mid-execution
openStream stores a new Stream struct in the streams mapping
openStream increases totalUnclaimedInStreams by the stream amount
openStream uses block.timestamp as the stream startTime (timestamp dependency)
canManageStreams gates openStream on msg.sender
isSubGov[msg.sender] grants stream management rights
recipient parameter is stored into the newly created stream
streamIndex returned by openStream identifies the created stream
openStream increments streamCount to allocate the next stream index
closeStream pays out pending amounts by calling payout
canManageStreams gates closeStream on msg.sender
streamId selects which stream is closed
onlyGovOrSubGov gates pay on msg.sender
isSubGov[msg.sender] grants payment rights
the breaker flag permanently disables pay
pay derives the accounting epoch from block.timestamp (timestamp dependency)
pay accumulates spentPerEpoch and enforces the MONTHLY_LIMIT bound
recipient parameter receives the transferred payment asset
amount parameter is checked against the monthly limit and transferred
pay makes an external token transfer through SafeERC20 low-level call after updating spend accounting
initialize stores block.timestamp into timeInitialized (timestamp dependency)
initialize writes timeInitialized
initialize is gated by onlyGov on msg.sender
execute closes existing vesting streams
execute opens replacement vesting streams
execute pays the monthly contributor allowances
execute exits the index staking position
execute sweeps INDEX tokens out of the staking helper
execute converts yearly USD salaries into monthly YUSD amounts
execute finishes by selfdestructing the StreamManager contract
update_twap requires elapsed block.timestamp to exceed the configured period (timestamp dependency)
period is the minimum time between TWAP updates enforced by update_twap
update_twap records the latest block timestamp
update_twap derives the average sell price from cumulative price differences divided by elapsed time
update_twap increments twap_counter
consult shifts and multiplies the TWAP average by the token decimals to build a quote
_getLPToken sets the complete flag so the action cannot be repeated
_getLPToken validates the Uniswap quote against TWAP bounds computed from consult
_getLPToken pulls both tokens from the reserves address into the Uniswap pair
uniswap_pair1 is the pair that receives the minted liquidity
sell_token is the limiting asset used for the quote and bounds check
stake mints LP through _getLPToken and then stakes it
getUnderlying calls _getUnderlyingToken
_getUnderlyingToken sets the complete flag
_getUnderlyingToken burns the LP of uniswap_pair1
delegateBySig recovers the signatory via ecrecover, so signature validity gates delegation
delegateBySig requires now <= expiry (timestamp dependency)
nonce parameter is compared against nonces[signatory] to prevent replay
the nonces mapping is consumed by delegateBySig
delegateBySig moves votes on behalf of the recovered signatory
expiry parameter bounds when the delegation signature may be used
permit recovers the owner from the signature before granting an allowance
permit requires now <= deadline (timestamp dependency)
permit increments nonces[owner] to prevent signature replay
permit writes the approved value into _allowedFragments[owner][spender]
_delegate moves votes between the previous and new representatives
_delegate reads _yamBalances[delegator] as the voting weight
_moveDelegates writes the new vote totals through _writeCheckpoint
assignSelfDelegate forces a self-delegation for a non-voting contract and is gated by onlyGov
onlyGov checks msg.sender for assignSelfDelegate
_becomeImplementation writes the implementation storage slot from within the delegate execution context
_becomeImplementation requires msg.sender to be the gov
the gov state variable is the authority checked by _becomeImplementation
delegatecall from the delegator runs _becomeImplementation against the proxy storage, so gov-controlled code can overwrite the implementation slot
_resignImplementation requires msg.sender to be the gov
the gov state variable is the authority checked by _resignImplementation
rescueTokens performs an external token transfer through the SafeERC20 low-level call path
rescueTokens is restricted to the gov by msg.sender comparison
the gov state variable authorizes rescueTokens
the Address/SafeERC20 call path uses assembly to inspect extcodesize before the transfer

normalization_plan.reason: The recipient parameter only carries the destination address consumed by the transfer balance writes.
The value parameter is the transferred amount that transfer converts into underlying YAM.
yamValue is the locally computed underlying amount used directly for the transfer balance arithmetic.
indexDelta is only meaningful as input to the rebase scaling factor arithmetic.
epoch is only used by rebase to label the emitted Rebase event.
positive is the branch selector of the rebase arithmetic.
newScalingFactor is the temporary candidate value written to the scaling factor inside rebase.
streamId selects the stream entry that payout reads and updates.
The recipient parameter is stored into the Stream struct opened by openStream.
The amount parameter is the value added to initSupply and totalSupply by mint.
The memory Stream copy is the data source used by _claimable, so it merges into that computation.
streamIndex is the newly allocated stream count returned by openStream.
claimableUnderlying is the amount paid out by payout after being computed by _claimable.
The nonce parameter is checked against the nonces mapping inside delegateBySig.
The expiry parameter is only used for the timestamp bound check inside delegateBySig.
